livingCost.basis: A single adult renting a studio in a typical large non-capital city: rent about 2,100 zł (Otodom Analytics, May 2026, studios up to 40 m2: Kraków 2,445, Wrocław 2,386, Poznań 2,100, Łódź 1,828, Katowice 1,825; Warsaw 2,957) + utilities and internet 450 + food about 1,200 + transport 130 + phone and basics 300 = about 4,180 zł net a month (about 50,200 a year). Under 2026 employment-contract tax and social-insurance rules that needs about 68,000 zł gross a year. A minimum-wage worker (57,672 gross, about 3,600 net a month) cannot afford this alone and usually shares a flat.

tuition.notes: Poland has no community colleges, and the most selective universities are public, so every cell is 0 for a full-time student at a public institution (Eurydice). Fees that remain: admission fee 85 zł per application, student ID 22 zł once. Fees are charged for part-time study, repeated courses, programmes taught in a foreign language and non-degree postgraduate courses. Private universities charge fees, which the game's tiers do not model: the press reports 2026/27 private medicine at 372,000-494,000 zł for the six years (about 60,000-92,000 a year), and part-time medicine at a public university at 26,000 zł a semester (https://biznes.o2.pl/biznes/prywatne-studia-lekarskie-czesne-siega-nawet-prawie-500-tys-zl-7307661715277824a). Private bachelor fees of a few thousand to tens of thousands of zł a year are my general knowledge, not sourced.

studentLoan.description: Kredyt studencki: a bank loan guaranteed and subsidised by the state, paid out as 400-1,000 zł a month to full-time students for up to six years (Student360/Pekao). The state pays the interest during study and a two-year grace period. After that the graduate repays over twice the borrowing time, at interest of half the NBP rediscount rate (1.9% now). Some bank pages describe the rate as 1.2 x rediscount + margin with the student paying half, which gives about 2.3-3.3%. The top 10% of graduates can have up to 50% cancelled. At 4.0% inflation the real rate is about -2%.

schooling.primarySchool: Szkoła podstawowa, an 8-year single-structure primary school for ages 7-15 (klasy 1-3 early school education, klasy 4-8 subject teaching), after one compulsory pre-school year (zerówka) at age 6; ends with the external egzamin ósmoklasisty
schooling.middleSchool: There is no separate lower-secondary school: klasy 4-8 (ages 10-15) of the szkoła podstawowa are that stage, after the 2017 reform replaced the 3-year gimnazjum
schooling.schoolLeaving: Matura (egzamin maturalny, świadectwo dojrzałości) at the end of liceum ogólnokształcące (4 years, ages 15-19) or technikum (5 years, ages 15-20)
schooling.vocational: Branżowa szkoła I stopnia (3-year sectoral vocational school, ages 15-18, then an optional 2-year branżowa szkoła II stopnia leading to the matura); technikum (5 years, vocational diploma plus matura); szkoła policealna (post-secondary vocational school, 1-2.5 years)
schooling.tierCommunity: Państwowa uczelnia zawodowa / Akademia Nauk Stosowanych (public university of applied sciences) or szkoła policealna: free when full-time
schooling.tierState: Uniwersytet or politechnika (public university), for example Uniwersytet Łódzki: free when full-time
schooling.tierElite: Uniwersytet Warszawski, Uniwersytet Jagielloński, Politechnika Warszawska, SGH (Szkoła Główna Handlowa): public and free, the most selective by matura points (my general knowledge of the rankings)
schooling.gradeName: Matura (egzamin maturalny), each subject scored as a percentage
schooling.gradeSystem: There is no single overall mark: every exam gets its own score from 0 to 100% and higher is better. To pass you need at least 30% in each mandatory exam (written Polish, mathematics and a modern language at basic level, plus oral Polish and oral language); the extended-level subjects have no pass mark, and you must take at least one. Typical 2026 results: basic Polish 59%, basic mathematics 59%, basic English 78%, extended mathematics 37%; 81.1% passed in the May session (85.9% of liceum and 71.3% of technikum graduates), and those who failed one exam can retake it in August. A top result is 90-100% (317 of 321,314 candidates scored 90-100% in every exam they took). There are no named bands on the certificate; universities turn the percentages, mainly extended subjects, into admission points. In class, pupils are graded 1-6 (6 best, 2 is a pass, 1 a fail).
schooling.startingAges: Compulsory pre-school year at 6; primary school 7-15 (grades 1-8); track split at about 15 after the grade-8 exam: liceum 4 years (15-19), technikum 5 years (15-20), branżowa szkoła I stopnia 3 years (15-18); compulsory education runs to 18. Higher education from about 19: licencjat or inżynier 3-4 years, magister 1.5-2 years, long-cycle master's (medicine 6, law 5) and 4-year doctoral school (my general knowledge for the cycle lengths).

highlights: Full-time study at public universities is free, even medicine and law, and the state student loan charges about 1.9% a year, less than the 4.0% inflation rate.
The minimum wage is 4,806 zł a month and the median worker earns about 7,500 zł; a specialist doctor's legal minimum is 12,910 zł and hospital specialists average about 24,000 zł.
caveats: Method. The web search tool ran out of budget, so I searched Google News RSS, fetched official GUS workbooks and read press pages; every URL above was opened. Most occupational pay comes from the GUS October 2024 earnings-structure survey (employers with 10 or more staff, part-time converted to full-time, pro-rated annual bonuses and the public-sector 13th salary included, so monthly x 12 is an annual figure). I lifted those medians to the 2026 level with a factor of 1.13, from the GUS monthly median series (2026 annual average of medians 7,754 zł against 6,857 in Oct 2024). Teachers use 1.0815 (the 2025 and 2026 pay-scale rises) and doctors and nurses use 2026 pay data directly. The survey leaves out firms under 10 staff, self-employed people and B2B contractors, and GUS has no figure for police, so police pay is from official police pages plus a press estimate of the 2026 average (low confidence). Specialist doctors on B2B contracts earn more than the AOTMiT average, and IT and pilot pay is often B2B too. Estimates, not sourced figures: the 1.13 uplift, food, transport and basics in the living-cost basket (net to gross done with 2026 rules: 13.71% social insurance, 9% health, 12% tax, 30,000 zł tax-free amount), the net to gross conversion of the Bulldogjob IT pay, pilots (low-quality press summaries), law, mechanical engineer and sales director (single survey or judgement). The inflation rate is a flash estimate relayed by Trading Economics, and the NBP rate is 3.75%. The student-loan formula differs between the ministry page (half the rediscount rate) and banks (1.2 x rediscount + margin, student pays half). The 2026 median and ninth decile are projections of actual 2025 data (86,956 and 172,644 zł), and the national figures come from ZUS data that may include some part-time earnings. The driving age of 17 comes from a gov.pl page updated in July 2026 and differs from the usual 18, so it is worth a second look.
